rules.card_final_draw_text: No fixture is known in advance: qualified players are drawn at the start of each round, from the playoffs to the final.
rules.card_final_score_text: The knockout stage is played with two beers: the winner scores 10 points.
rules.card_pools_all_text: Each pool is a full round-robin: 10 matches with 5 players, 15 with 6, 21 with 7. One seed per pool, taken from the ACP ranking; the other players are drawn pool after pool by an innocent hand.
rules.card_pools_score_text: Pool matches are played with one beer: the winner scores 5 points.
rules.card_tiebreak_text: Between pools of different sizes: win ratio, then cap’s average per match. Still tied at three or more: one three-way match, first to 3 points.
rules.card_uneven_text: When pools differ in size, players in the smaller pools drink a beer between the draw and the first match.
rules.game_heading: Two players. One target. One point at a time.
rules.game_lead: Players throw their cap in turn. A hit is answered by the opponent; the point is scored if the opponent misses in return.
rules.note_text: hitting the beer and knocking off the cap on top of it scores no point.
rules.page_lead: A game of skill: knock the cap off the opponent’s beer. How a point plays out, the eight golden rules, how the tournament works and the variants.
rules.step_counter_text: If the opponent hits too, nobody scores.
rules.step_point_text: If the opponent misses the cap, the thrower scores a point.
rules.step_reply_text: After a hit, the opponent plays in turn.
rules.step_throw_text: The player throws their cap at the cap sitting on the opponent’s beer.
rules.variant_bowling_figure: Top view: ten beers in a triangle on four rows, one, two, three then four.
rules.variant_bowling_text: 10 beers set in a triangle, like bowling pins.
rules.variant_podium_figure: Front view: three beers on plinths, the highest in the centre, the medium one on the left, the lowest on the right.
rules.variant_podium_text: 3 heights: high in the centre, medium on the left, low on the right.
rules.variant_pyramid_figure: Top view: three beers in a triangle, one at the front and two at the back.
rules.variants_lead: The main rules stay the same; only the beer layout changes.
rules.variants_note: Whatever the variant, the main rules (hit, counter cap’s, lumberjack, finishing your beer) stay the same.

legal.accessibility.known_suggestions: In the administration area (not public pages), the suggestion menu of the participant search exposes invalid ARIA roles (Origam component, issue no. 1331).
